title: Dominoes: Classic Dominos Game
description: Dominoes is definitely one of the most famous board game in the world. There are dozens of rules out there, but three modes are getting most of the attention: - Draw dominoes: simple, relaxing, play your tiles on either side of the board. You only need to match the tile you have with one of the 2 ends already on the board. - Block dominoes: basically the same as Draw Dominoes. The main difference is you have to pass your turn if you run out of options (whereas you can pick an extra domino from the boneyard in the previous mode). - Dominoes All Five: slightly more complex. Each turn, you need to add all ends of the board, and count the number of pips on them. If it is a multiple of five, you score those points. A bit difficult at first but you will quickly get it! NEW - Become VIP: Choose your subscription’s type (weekly, monthly, yearly) and enjoy your Domino game without any advertisement. Beautiful, simple, relaxing, easy to learn yet complex if you get to learn all the tricks! Will you be a Dominoes master?

title: Dominoes All Fives - Offline
description:
ALL FIVES DOMINOES — THE CLASSIC YOU LOVE
Play All Fives dominoes the way it was meant to be played: offline, free, vs a smart AI that actually challenges you. No wifi. No signup. No waiting.
All Fives is the world's most-loved scoring variant of dominoes. Match tiles, count the open ends, and score every time the total hits a multiple of 5. Easy to learn. A lifetime to master.

✓ Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese (BR & PT), and French

PLAY ANYWHERE, ANYTIME — NO WIFI NEEDED
No signal? No problem. All Fives Dominoes works completely offline. Perfect for flights, commutes, or unwinding without distractions.

NEW TO ALL FIVES? START HERE
The interactive tutorial walks you through:
• How dominos are matched (pip values, doubles, the boneyard)
• How All Fives scoring works (multiples of 5)
• When to block, when to draw from the boneyard
• Strategy tips to outscore the AI
Whether you played All Fives with grandparents or you've never touched a domino tile, you'll be scoring within minutes.

MASTER THE STRATEGY
All Fives is more strategic than block dominoes. Every tile placement matters. Count pips, watch the spinner, set traps for the AI, and race to your target score. Doubles open up extra branches — use them wisely.

GAME MODES
• QUICK GAME — instant 1v1 vs the AI. Perfect for short breaks.
• ADVENTURE — a themed campaign with progressive challenges and unlockable rewards.

DOWNLOAD ALL FIVES DOMINOES TODAY
Free. Offline. Classic. Start your dominoes adventure in 10 seconds.

ABOUT THE ALL FIVES RULES (FOR NEW PLAYERS)
The All Fives variant of dominoes (also called "Muggins" or "Five-Up") is a scoring game played with a standard double-six domino set. After each play, if the sum of the open ends of the layout is divisible by 5, the active player scores that sum. The first to reach the target score wins.
Doubles are placed perpendicular to the line ("crosswise") and count both ends in the open-ends total. The "spinner" — the first double played — opens up two extra branches, making spatial strategy critical.

COMMON DOMINOES QUESTIONS
How do you play dominoes?
Match tile pips end-to-end. In All Fives, you score when the open ends total a multiple of 5 (5, 10, 15, 20…).
Can you play dominoes solo?
Yes — All Fives Dominoes: Reef Adventure lets you play 1v1 vs a smart AI offline, no second player needed.
Are dominoes free to play here?
Yes, the full game is free. 
Do I need wifi for dominoes?
No — this game runs 100% offline. Play on a plane, the subway, or anywhere with zero signal.
What dominoes set is used?
The classic double-six set (28 tiles), the standard for All Fives.
Get All Fives Dominoes free today and master the classic dominos board game — your way, on your schedule.
